Complete the Plan.

Add this card to your pool of objectives. Destroy it at the end of the game in which you complete the objective.

mechanics.whenRead: The mandatory objective enclosed by 11-03. Read during the first November setup draw. The steps are on 11-05, The Plan.
destroys: this objective card, at the end of the game in which the Plan is completed
rules: Add this card to the pool of objectives.
Destroy it at the end of the game in which you complete the objective.
mechanics.notes: Side A is the objective back (blue star) and still prints 11-04a. Side B text is vertical, with a red MANDATORY OBJECTIVE label. Completing the objective is checking every box on 11-05b. This card waits until that game's end; 11-05b destroys The Plan card itself as soon as the last box is checked.
